title: Establishing Meta-Decision Making for AI: An Ontology of Relevance, Representation and Reasoning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not present a benchmark and does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes a conceptual ontology for meta-decision-making in AI.
findings: This paper does not discuss, analyze, or mention any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on a general framework for AI decision-making, ethics, and safety.
